title: Add Vault response caching with TTL
description: Vault keys fetched synchronously without caching. Every key retrieval makes a Vault request, impacting performance if Vault has high latency. Implement in-memory caching with configurable TTL, cache refresh before expiry, metrics for hits/misses, graceful fallback to Vault on cache miss.
